name: live-vibe
description: /live: full-duplex voice (Kyutai streaming STT with semantic end of turn, or Silero and Whisper; Kokoro TTS) through a sidecar; /vibe: director mode that delegates all work to subagents; /livevibe: talk with a fast voice front that hands the work to Claude as director.

stt.title: Speech recognizer
stt.description: kyutai: Kyutai STT 1B on MLX (Apple silicon) or CUDA PyTorch (Linux with an Nvidia GPU; elsewhere whisper runs instead), streaming words that ends your turn on what you said rather than on a fixed pause; downloads about 2.4 GB on first use. whisper: Silero VAD plus faster-whisper (on an Nvidia GPU when CUDA works, else the CPU), sized by the next setting; also the automatic fallback.

asr.title: faster-whisper model
asr.description: For the whisper recognizer: tiny.en is fastest, small.en most accurate.

tts.title: Speech synthesizer
tts.description: kokoro needs espeak-ng (`brew install espeak-ng`, `sudo apt install espeak-ng`); say is the zero-download macOS fallback.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: A Kokoro voice (af_heart) or a macOS say voice (Samantha). Empty means the synthesizer's default.

mic.title: Microphone
mic.description: An input device index or a part of its name ("AirPods"). Empty means the system default. `uv run --script bin/sidecar/main.py --list-devices` lists them.

speaker.title: Speaker
speaker.description: An output device index or a part of its name. Empty means the system default. A laptop's own speakers and mic together bleed your answers into the mic; headphones work best. With the Windows speaker backend, a part of a Windows device name.

speakerBackend.title: Speaker backend
speakerBackend.description: auto: under WSL, play speech on Windows directly (WASAPI, through win_player.exe, a small native player the plugin ships; /live setup stages it in %LOCALAPPDATA%\live-vibe), since WSLg's audio adds crackle; elsewhere the local speaker. local: always the local speaker (WSLg under WSL). windows: the Windows player, falling back to local with a warning when it cannot start.

endSilenceMs.title: Pause that ends an utterance (ms)
endSilenceMs.description: With kyutai, the model decides when you are done (about 0.8 s after you stop); this is the longest pause it waits through when it is unsure, cut to 1 s after a finished sentence. With whisper, it is the silence after speech before it is sent; raise it if you get cut off mid-sentence.

endSilenceLongMs.title: Pause allowed mid-thought (ms)
endSilenceLongMs.description: With kyutai, the pause allowed when the model predicts you will keep talking or your sentence looks unfinished (it ends on a comma or a word like and, so or the); never shorter than the pause above.

frontBackend.title: Live vibe: voice front backend
frontBackend.description: llamacpp: llama.cpp llama-server (run for you while frontUrl is empty) or any OpenAI-compatible chat server that takes response_format with a JSON schema. anthropic: Claude through the API; needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or `ant auth login`.

frontUrl.title: Live vibe: front server URL
frontUrl.description: Empty: /livevibe runs its own llama.cpp llama-server (/live setup downloads it and a small model) and stops it with live vibe. Set it to use a server you run instead, such as http://127.0.0.1:8080 or http://gpu-box:8080; then nothing starts locally.

frontServerBin.title: Live vibe: managed server binary
frontServerBin.description: With frontUrl empty: an existing llama-server to run (e.g. ~/src/llama.cpp/build/bin/llama-server). Empty means the pinned llama.cpp release /live setup downloads (CUDA 12 on Linux with an Nvidia GPU, Metal on Apple silicon).

frontServerModel.title: Live vibe: managed server model
frontServerModel.description: With frontUrl empty: an existing GGUF file to serve. Empty means the default small model, which /live setup downloads (Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 Q4_K_M, 2.5 GB).

frontServerLog.title: Live vibe: managed server log
frontServerLog.description: With frontUrl empty: the file the server's output is appended to. Empty means ~/.cache/duplex_voice/front-server.log (LIVE_VIBE_CACHE or XDG_CACHE_HOME move it).

frontModel.title: Live vibe: front model
frontModel.description: Empty: whatever the llamacpp server serves, or claude-haiku-4-5 for anthropic. Set it when the server hosts several models.

logFile.title: Sidecar log file
logFile.description: Where the sidecar appends its log (startup, fallbacks, warnings, library output), 5 MB then one rotated copy. Empty means ~/.cache/duplex_voice/sidecar.log (LIVE_VIBE_CACHE or XDG_CACHE_HOME move it).
